optimizedDescription.value: Central change aggregate owns lifecycle, scope, consent, verification, artifacts, implementation tracking, history, and archive recovery.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules
- Identity: immutable unique slug `name`, `createdAt`; reject whole-slug Windows device names `con|prn|aux|nul|com1..com9|lpt1..lpt9` case-insensitively. `ActorIdentity`: `name`, `email`, optional `provider`, `providerId`, `metadata`. `updatedAt >= createdAt`; omitted defaults to `createdAt`; `touchUpdatedAt(at = new Date())` advances it.
- Scope: mutable empty-valid canonical `specIds`; validate workspace on creation. Derived plural `workspaces` via `parseSpecId()`, never persisted/primary/indexed. `specDependsOn` is `CompileContext` highest-priority source; scope replacement prunes removed keys. Canonical additions/removals stale spec consent with precise diffs; reorder/duplicates do not. Active edits use canonical reconciliation; scope edit alone never forces redesign.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`. `VALID_TRANSITIONS` authoritative. Legacy pending/approved states drain only. Approval gates `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default false; enabled gates keep change in `ready`/`done` until valid consent. Every state except `drafting` may return `designing`; application-level `designing → designing` neutral no-op, while entity rejects real self-transition. `verifying → verifying` invalid.
- Retry: `done|signed-off|archivable → implementing|verifying` is retry, not redesign; preserves unchanged artifacts/spec approval, invalidates active signoff. `archiving` permits manual `archivable|designing`; central reconciliation alone may apply `archiving → done` for mandatory signoff recovery.
- `implementing → verifying` requires configured task completion. `verifying → implementing` only for implementation repair; artifact/task revision returns `designing`. Lifecycle movement alone neither captures/completes nor invalidates verification.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` has `type`, `optional`, ordered `requires`, aggregate state, files. File has `key`, `filename`, canonical state, `validatedHash`, `hasDrift`; canonical states `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`. Legacy wire review state coerces. Aggregate precedence drifted > pending > complete > skipped > missing > in-progress. Only optional artifacts may skip; `complete|skipped` satisfy dependencies. `markComplete` reserved for validation; `markSkipped` for skip use case.
- Invalidation: structured `{artifacts: none|surgical|downstream|global, workflow: preserve|redesign}`; expand with schema `ArtifactDag`, exclude task artifacts from propagated drift review, append focused audit evidence. `hasDrift` changes only for focused `artifact-drift`; manual review neither sets nor clears it. Central reconciler applies gate recovery: required stale spec consent → `designing`; required stale signoff → `done`; spec recovery wins; never advance earlier state. Reapplication idempotent.
- Consent: spec approval in `ready` requires validated reviewed artifacts, no unresolved drift, and fingerprint of exact sorted canonical `specIds` plus non-task artifacts. Signoff in `done` requires current artifacts, implementation fingerprint, and valid verification. Projections persist `valid|stale|revoked`, actor/reason/time/cause; legacy missing scope/implementation evidence is unknown, never fabricated. Hash equality never heals invalidity.
- Verification: explicit start from any active state refreshes tracking/resolution, checks files/links, captures current non-task artifact + implementation baseline, appends `verification-attempt-started`; repeat supersedes active attempt but preserves history. Complete requires active attempt and exact fresh inputs, then records valid completion/event. Explicit invalidation requires reason. Operations do not run tests or transition lifecycle; central reconciliation owns recovery.
- Implementation tracking: persist `implementationTrackingStartedAt`, tracked project-relative files `open|resolved|ignored|removed`, and confirmed spec/file links with optional symbols plus explicit-vs-container-only file-link intent. Activation idempotent. `removed` persists until refresh finds file. Historical implementing fact gates autodetection.
- Fingerprints: deterministic complete-key maps. `text-v1` strips initial BOM, normalizes CRLF/CR to LF, trailing horizontal whitespace, whitespace-only lines, final newline; no parsing/formatting/internal-whitespace or symbol-range hashing. Binary byte-hash records algorithm. Missing/unreadable linked files fail. Task artifacts excluded from approval/verification fingerprints but remain required/validated/live-counted.
- History append-only; state derives latest `transitioned`. Record creation, transitions, approvals, invalidations, verification, draft/restore/discard, skip/sync, description, archive failure. Archive only from `archivable`; failure records step/message/`commitStarted`; successful restore returns `archivable`, failed restore stays `archiving`.
- Draft moves active storage without lifecycle change; restore reverses. Drafted changes read-only except restore/discard via draft mutation. Discard irreversible, requires reason/actor, optional `supersededBy`. Draft/discard after historical implementation require force.
- Entity owns persisted facts; `evaluateLifecycleVerdict`/`projectArtifacts` own schema-DAG effective status, checks, blockers, available hops, and next action. Workflow rows are not participating-state authority.

## Constraints
- History immutable/append-only; lifecycle from transitions; projection invalidity never self-heals.
- Artifact/file state and `hasDrift` authoritative; `validatedHash` baseline only.
- No primary workspace. Approval gates opt-in. Archive source states only `archivable|archiving`.
- Task completion derives schema `hasTasks`, task check, and workflow requirements; task text is not approval evidence.
- Change domain stays I/O-free; application use cases provide schema, checks, fingerprints, actor, reconciliation, persistence.
